method.base_distribution: uniform frame-wise permutations with frame zero fixing global labels
method.tempering: adaptive ESS; systematic resampling at every stage
method.mutation: Metropolis single-frame and contiguous-segment label swaps, with additional rejuvenation at beta=1

gate_definition.association_tv: at most max(0.05, 3 * exact-draw MC q95)
gate_definition.association_js: at most max(0.01, 3 * exact-draw MC q95)
gate_definition.credible_set_recall_95: at least the 5th percentile of equal-size exact posterior draws
gate_definition.exact_mass_covered: at least max(0.95, 5th percentile of exact posterior draws)
gate_definition.path_sliced_wasserstein: at most max(1 um, 3 * independent exact-draw baseline)
gate_definition.aggregate_rule: every repeat in every frozen regime must pass
gate_definition.map_interpretation: TV, JS, recall, and the absolute 95% mass floor are checked in every cell; the q05 mass-support check is reported as a finite-sample diagnostic and is expected to reject about 5% of exact finite samples
